conventions.empty_word: known signature coefficient 1; Id(0)=0; no unital evaluation injectivity claimed
conventions.hall_order: increasing degree, then lexicographic standard-Lyndon order
conventions.tanh_jet_coefficients: ordinary Taylor coefficients f^(n)(0)/n!, including n=0
conventions.word_order: chronological: earliest differential on the left

implementation_limits.meaning: finite computational guardrails, not restrictions of the theorem

limitations: the numerical values of q and tanh are never approximated in these checks
the matrix need not equal (1/2) I; only its selected diagonal grade blocks do
the nonlinear fields are not assumed to represent the truncated Lie or tensor quotient
the local-recovery conclusion concerns the degree-L truncated polynomial, not the full CDE endpoint
no linear-readout approximation, word-family independence at width nu, or conditioning bound is certified
no conclusion for singular parameter laws follows from full-space analytic genericity alone

method.finite_jet_orders: generator ordinary Taylor degree L-1; retain degree L-m after a word of length m
method.grading_padding: E is inverted only on the positive-degree active space; inactive coordinates are recorded as zero
method.matrix_construction: actual finite tanh jets, chronological word differentiation and the existing Hall word expansions
method.rank_check: exact elimination using existing determinant and matrix-rank utilities
method.witness: A_i=-E^(-1) ad_(e_i) E, b_i=q e_i, q=atanh(1/2), on the graded quotient or active embedding

reproduction.comparison: recompute and compare the entire deterministic JSON payload

scope.architecture: V_i(x)=tanh(A_i x+b_i), componentwise, full biased parameter family
scope.claim_checked: rank H_theta=min(D,nu) at the listed finite exact witnesses
scope.genericity: the all-d,D,L proof and analytic zero-set argument are in the theorem note; finite cases alone do not prove them
